refnamediv.refpurpose: Get information regarding a specific transfer

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
If option is given, returns its value. Otherwise, returns an associative array with the following elements (which correspond to option), or &false; on failure:
"url" (string)
"content_type" (string|null)
"http_code" (int)
"header_size" (int)
"request_size" (int)
"filetime" (int)
"ssl_verify_result" (int)
"redirect_count" (int)
"total_time" (float)
"namelookup_time" (float)
"connect_time" (float)
"pretransfer_time" (float)
"size_upload" (float)
"size_download" (float)
"speed_download" (float)
"speed_upload" (float)
"download_content_length" (float)
"upload_content_length" (float)
"starttransfer_time" (float)
"redirect_time" (float)
"redirect_url" (string)
"primary_ip" (string)
"certinfo" (array)
"primary_port" (int)
"local_ip" (string)
"local_port" (int)
"http_version" (int), one of the CURL_HTTP_VERSION_* constants. Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"protocol" (int), one of the CURLPROTO_* constants. Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"ssl_verifyresult" (int), the result of the certificate verification that was requested (distinct from "ssl_verify_result" above, which is the result of the proxy certificate verification). Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"scheme" (string). Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"appconnect_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "connect_time" for the SSL/SSH connect/handshake. Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"queue_time_us" (int). Available as of PHP 8.5.0 and cURL 8.6.0
"connect_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "connect_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"namelookup_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "namelookup_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"pretransfer_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "pretransfer_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"redirect_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "redirect_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"starttransfer_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "starttransfer_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"posttransfer_time_us" (int). Available as of PHP 8.4.0 and cURL 8.10.0
"total_time_us" (int), the microsecond-resolution counterpart of "total_time". Available as of PHP 7.3.0
"request_header" (string) (This is only set if the CURLINFO_HEADER_OUT is set by a previous call to curl_setopt)
"effective_method" (string), the last used effective HTTP method. Available as of PHP 8.2.0 and cURL 7.72.0
"capath" (string), the built-in default CA path string. Available as of PHP 8.3.0 and cURL 7.84.0
"cainfo" (string), the built-in default CA certificate path. Available as of PHP 8.3.0 and cURL 7.84.0
"used_proxy" (int), whether a proxy was used for this transfer. Available as of PHP 8.5.0 and cURL 8.7.0
"httpauth_used" (int), the actually used HTTP authentication method, one of the CURLAUTH_* constants. Available as of PHP 8.5.0 and cURL 8.12.0
"proxyauth_used" (int), the actually used proxy authentication method, one of the CURLAUTH_* constants. Available as of PHP 8.5.0 and cURL 8.12.0
"conn_id" (int), the ID of the last connection used by the transfer. Available as of PHP 8.5.0 and cURL 8.2.0
The "content_type", "scheme" and "redirect_url" keys hold an empty string, rather than &false;, when the corresponding information is unavailable; this differs from calling this function with the matching option, where the same condition returns &false; (or &null; for "content_type"). Note that private data is not included in the associative array and must be retrieved individually with the CURLINFO_PRIVATE option.

&reftitle.changelog;
&Version; &Description;
8.5.0
Added the conn_id, httpauth_used, proxyauth_used, queue_time_us and used_proxy array keys.
8.4.0
Introduced CURLINFO_POSTTRANSFER_TIME_T constant and posttransfer_time_us (Curl 8.10.0 or later).
8.3.0
Introduced CURLINFO_CAINFO and CURLINFO_CAPATH.
8.2.0
Introduced CURLINFO_PROXY_ERROR, CURLINFO_REFERER, CURLINFO_RETRY_AFTER, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_METHOD constant and effective_method.
&curl.changelog.handle-param;
8.0.0
option is nullable now; previously, the default was 0.
7.3.0
Introduced CURLINFO_CONTENT_LENGTH_DOWNLOAD_T, CURLINFO_CONTENT_LENGTH_UPLOAD_T, CURLINFO_HTTP_VERSION, CURLINFO_PROTOCOL, CURLINFO_PROXY_SSL_VERIFYRESULT, CURLINFO_SCHEME, CURLINFO_SIZE_DOWNLOAD_T, CURLINFO_SIZE_UPLOAD_T, CURLINFO_SPEED_DOWNLOAD_T, CURLINFO_SPEED_UPLOAD_T, CURLINFO_APPCONNECT_TIME_T, CURLINFO_CONNECT_TIME_T, CURLINFO_FILETIME_T, CURLINFO_NAMELOOKUP_TIME_T, CURLINFO_PRETRANSFER_TIME_T, CURLINFO_REDIRECT_TIME_T, CURLINFO_STARTTRANSFER_TIME_T, CURLINFO_TOTAL_TIME_T.

&reftitle.notes;
Information gathered by this function is kept if the handle is re-used. This means that unless a statistic is overridden internally by this function, the previous info is returned.
